subject: integration
name: Gnosis network standard (GNOSIS_NET_0_1)
summary: Defines 8 reads of Gnosis Chain (id 100, xDAI as hexadecimal wei) and broadcasting a signed transaction, with a READONLY profile. A call follows no CCIP-Read, so a revert asking for an offchain lookup is answered as a revert. The row runs nothing and names no node. It says a verified node proves each log against its block's receipt but not that the list is complete, and cannot prove a block older than 8191 blocks; whether a node proves anything is its own row's matter. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
